thesis: The founders of Happy Robot argue that voice AI serves as a critical unlock for enterprise operations, particularly in supply chain logistics, by enabling agents to perform complex tasks like negotiating shipment rates and tracking goods over the phone. They emphasize that success in this domain depends not just on model intelligence, but on building custom infrastructure to handle messy real-world environments, prevent hallucinations during negotiations, and coordinate across fragmented systems within large organizations.
